sources.name: Adzuna Jobs API
sources.scope: The official search specification lists Switzerland (ch). An app_id and app_key are required. A live Swiss query and permission to redistribute results still require confirmation.

sources.name: EU ESCO occupations and skills
sources.scope: Multilingual occupation and skill taxonomy. The occupation search supplies terminology, not Swiss job demand. An official downloadable classification is available.

sources.name: BFS STATPOP population
sources.scope: Annual permanent and non-permanent resident population by canton and citizenship. The referenced cube is the 2025 release; population counts and new work permits are separate measures.

sources.name: BFS BESTA employment in NOGA 62–63
sources.scope: Quarterly Swiss full-time equivalents in IT and information services (NOGA 62–63), an employment measure. The referenced XLSX is the Q2 2026 edition. BFS requires source attribution.

sources.name: SEM foreign population and permits
sources.scope: Monthly administrative statistics. The sample is table 2-20, October 2026 stock of permanent foreign residents by permit type, published on 19 November 2026. The rolling index links the latest monthly release.

sources.name: opendata.swiss catalogue
sources.scope: CKAN dataset discovery and resource links. Each publisher supplies its own usage terms, geography and release cadence.

sources.name: Swiss Parliament Open Data Webservice
sources.scope: Current parliamentary business and proceedings interface. Requires registration and an X-API-KEY header. Use the published OpenAPI specification for an authenticated integration.

sources.name: Swiss Parliament legacy OData
sources.scope: Transitional public parliamentary business feed. The provider plans to retire ws.parlament.ch by the end of 2028. A returned parliamentary item does not establish current law.

sources.name: Fedlex federal legislation
sources.scope: Federal legislation metadata and links to consolidated texts. The sample requests one metadata match for the Foreign Nationals and Integration Act (FNIA). Effective dates and consolidation versions require verification against each text.

sources.name: SEM news and media releases
sources.scope: Official change signals and announcements. Verify the status and effective date of proposed rule changes in the published legal text.
